summary: First testing pass for Copper Strip Corrosion Rating Analyzer. All 13 backend pytest cases pass (root, ASTM reference of 12 ratings, analyze happy-path + invalid data URL, list filters/date/search/include_image, GET by id, PATCH, PDF, CSV, DELETE + 404). Full frontend E2E via Playwright also passes: Analyzer page loads, all 12 ASTM swatches (astm-swatch-1a..4c) present, file upload -> preview -> analyze -> result-card with rating/category/description/confidence rendered, POST /api/analyze returned 1B/Slight Tarnish for the copper-toned JPEG. History page shows the new row, detail-dialog opens, search filter returns the row, delete flow removes it, export-csv-btn present. GPT-5.2 vision via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER analyze_with_ai references it (logger.exception on LLM error). If the LLM call throws before line 420, this will raise NameError. Move logging.basicConfig / logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) to the top of the module (right after imports).
server.py exceeds separation-of-concerns but is still ~430 lines (acceptable). Consider extracting PDF generation into a service module if it grows.
date_from/date_to filter compares ISO strings to created_at ISO strings; works for UTC ISO but is fragile if created_at ever includes timezone offsets other than Z. Consider proper datetime parsing.
PATCH route allows updating with both fields set to empty string (allowed since only None is filtered out). Acceptable per spec.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral records (TEST_ prefix) and clean up via DELETE at end of the flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use PIL to generate a real copper-toned JPEG with texture (see conftest.py _make_copper_jpeg_data_url). Do NOT use solid-color images -- image_testing.md forbids it. Backend base URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api. Pytest runs in 10s; frontend analyze call takes ~10-15s waiting on GPT-5.2. Latest AI returned rating 1B (Slight Tarnish) which matches the light copper-orange test image.
